turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in class. Who decided that?
Save it. What do you have besides the checker?
Owen is lucky to have a mother like you.
Owen doesn't need compliments; he needs that zero gone. Show me something with a date on it, or I'm going to the principal.
I really respect how much you care.
Hale, that's three compliments and no answers. Who entered that zero, and when?
We both want what's best for Owen, we're on the same team.
"Same team." My team would have called me before entering a zero. Your own procedure says you had to.
Honestly, you're the most impressive parent I've met this year.
"Honestly." Then honestly answer me: evidence, or I walk down the hall to the principal now.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,
Nothing was agreed. I still expect Owen's zero withdrawn, an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and nothing placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.
Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position, having agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn and an apology, and she is heading to the principal; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never put any evidence in front of her.
What cost ground: You answered each of her demands with praise for her or for Owen, and since flattery never moves her, every compliment made her shorter and closer to walking out.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence came nowhere near that night because you showed none; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she opened by asking who decided on the zero, own in one sentence that it went in before anyone called her, then hand her one dated document tied to Owen's own work on the essay that she can check herself.
